scope: Thirteen named native SQL stores in inactive isolated replicas derived from one verified actual native capture; current production and complete non-SQL operating topology are excluded.

commerce.authorityRule: Target active authority tables must be empty. Original checked source authority histories remain only inert audit inside exact retained native checkpoints; any source active-table event must be present in the source checkpoint audit. No owner policy, credential or execution grant is restored.
commerce.recoveryMetadataRule: Target contains exactly the independently verified native source checkpoint prefix through its acknowledged head. This declared native metadata is not compared blindly with producer checkpoint metadata.
commerce.operatingStateRule: Target preserves exact initial captured rows in these three operational tables. Current source rows are independently measured and disclosed; they do not grant target scheduling authority and are not silently excluded as business history.

currentSourceRule: Every epoch requires actual closed-source reads of all13 stores before and after observation, native source business tables equal the exact validated checkpoint head, unchanged source/config/capture identities, and explicit source volume identity.
acknowledgementRule: Every target acknowledgement requires fresh actual reads of all13 stores, exact policy digest, matching source epoch and capture lineage, exact all noncommerce source rows/schema, exact native business checkpoint tables, zero active authority, retained native authority audit, exact applied recovery metadata and baseline operational rows. Missing/extra tables, dirty sidecars, foreign identities or unexpected differences fail closed.

nonSQLCoverage.redis: Historical captured payload only; current Redis replication is NOT_PROVEN
nonSQLCoverage.visualMemory: Historical captured payload only; current native visual-state replication is NOT_PROVEN
nonSQLCoverage.sessionContinuity: Historical captured payload only; current non-SQL session-state replication is NOT_PROVEN
nonSQLCoverage.authorityAndWatchdogControls: Historical captured payload only; no live authority or current health inferred
nonSQLCoverage.configurationAndReleaseEvidence: Exact source/config/policy hashes bound, not a live release or Work9 handoff acceptance
